text:
julia: Heads-up — noticed a small regression on P95 token latency for routing-heavy routes. Suspect sampler/batcher entropy change + kernel switch events. Can we add lightweight metrics to debug? 

mike: +1. let's add: `runtime_batch_size_histogram`, `queue_wait_seconds_bucket`, `kernel_switch_count{from,to}`, and `kv_cache_hit_ratio`. Keep them low-cardinality. 

rik: I captured a flame sample during the spike, kernel switch spikes line up with `batch_shape` changes. snippet:

```
# node 12: profiler sample
kernel_select() -> fallthrough -> pack_smallbatch
time: 23.4ms
batch_shape: [1,4]
queue_wait: 9.8ms
```

rik: Suggest adding token-level breakdown metric: `token_latency_split{compute,kv_lookup,serialize}` so we can pin the slow stage.

anya: KV cold-start looks correlated. For quick debugging panels, try these PromQLs:
```
# batch size distribution
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_batch_size_histogram[5m])) by (le))

# queue wait p99
quantile_over_time(0.99, rate(queue_wait_seconds_bucket[5m]))

# kernel switch rate
sum(rate(kernel_switch_count[5m])) by (from,to)
```

anya: Also add an annotation when we roll kernel-chooser commits so dashboards can be correlated.

alex: For per-route KPIs: expose `route_p95_token_latency` and `route_throughput_tokens` as tags, and dashboard rows: summary (SLA), batch histogram, token split, kv hit ratio, kernel switches. Keep rows collapsible.

mike: Can we emit a lightweight tag `batch_entropy` (low-card int 0-3) — cheap and helps group shapes without high cardinality. Example export:
```
metric: runtime_batch_entropy
labels: entropy="2"
value: 1
```

infra-bot: alert: perf-regression-detection triggered for service=runtime, p95 increase 18% in last 10m. [link to incident  #INC-4521]

julia: Nice. Action items: 1) add metrics above (mike/anya) 2) dashboard PR (alex) 3) enable annotation hook for kernel-chooser commits (rik). Aim for quick iteration tomorrow. :thumbsup:

mike: I'll push exporter changes; will keep new labels optional behind flag.

rik: I'll add profiler labels so traces map to `batch_entropy` and kernel id.

anya: I'll draft the PromQL panels and mock screenshots.

alex: I'll stub the Grafana dashboard and wire alerts to a temporary channel.

julia: Thanks — if anyone hits a blocker ping @julia. Quick wins first: batch histogram + token split.
